sources.findings: Lasair is a full-stream Rubin broker. SQL, contextual crossmatching, and ready-made Gaia white-dwarf resources are advertised. This does not establish a complete Gaia-first stable-star archive.

API authentication uses a personal key obtained from the logged-in profile. User-token limits: 100 calls/hour and 10,000 query rows; power access requires contact. The displayed query/object examples target Lasair-ZTF; no anonymous Rubin direct-science plus forced-quality history contract is established here.
Registration with an email address enables API/client and personal query/watchlist facilities. No account was created or used.

LSST lightcurves are described as difference flux in nJy; the forced measurement is also described on difference images. This is not documentation of direct scienceFlux plus errors and quality fields.

Historical alert queries and watchlists are described, including a past-object crossmatch for watchlists below 10,000 sources. These remain alert-associated objects, not an unconditional stellar forced-photometry survey.
Statistics API supports YYYYMM selection; each returned row represents an observing night. Only aggregate metadata are needed for this feasibility step.
